title: Intel
markdown:
Get statistics related to intels in the Collaborate Analyst Portal.

As an analyst, you can use the following API endpoints to access detailed statistics related to threat indicators and intel sharing:

*   **Get Intel with Indicators**: Retrieve the number of intel submissions that include or exclude associated threat indicators.
    
*   **Get Intel Sharing Info**: Access detailed information regarding the sharing of intel, including how and with whom it is shared.
